title: Workspaces
subtitle: Every workspace bundles its agents, activity and connections
emptyNone: A workspace is where you and your agents work together. Join one with a pairing code, paste an invitation link, or create a new one.

toast.renamedWorkspace: Renamed to "{{name}}" for everyone in the workspace

remove.title: Remove "{{name}}"?
remove.description: Removed from this launcher only. Agents bound to it are unbound; the workspace and its other members are untouched, and you can add it back from its link.
remove.descriptionRemote: Deleted for every member — channels, history and connected devices go with it. No undo in the app.
remove.alsoDelete: Delete it on the server too — all members
remove.alsoDeleteWarning: Everyone loses access immediately. Only an admin restoring the record by hand can undo it.

card.noAgents: No agent is connected to this workspace
card.deviceLinked: No agent is bound here yet — install one on this device from the workspace.
card.trendTruncated: Counted from the most recent messages only; earlier days may read low
card.deviceBadgeHint: This machine is paired to this workspace as a node — agents can be installed and run on it from there.
card.revokedTitle: This device was removed from the workspace
card.revokedBody: Its pairing was revoked on the workspace side. Agents here can no longer reach it — re-pair with a new code to reconnect.

quickConnect.title: Add a workspace
quickConnect.pairHint: In the workspace, open $t(common.workspaceMenu.connectAgent) → $t(common.workspaceMenu.nodes). This device joins as a node, and you install and run agents on it from there. Codes work once and expire after 30 minutes.
quickConnect.pairError: A pairing code is 8 characters, like XXXX-XXXX.
quickConnect.pasteHint: The link has to carry ?token=, and one copied from the address bar does not. In the workspace, click the avatar at the bottom left → $t(common.workspaceMenu.copyToken) — or open the QR button beside it and click the code, which copies a link with the token in it.

toast.pasteFirst: Paste a workspace URL or token
toast.registered: Registered {{label}}. Open Agents tab to connect an agent.

error.tls: Workspace service is temporarily unreachable (TLS certificate mismatch). Please try again later or contact support.
error.dns: Cannot reach the workspace service. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.timeout: Workspace service didn't respond in time. Please try again in a moment.
error.linkMissingToken: That workspace link carries no token, and one copied from the address bar never does. In the workspace, click the avatar at the bottom left → $t(common.workspaceMenu.copyToken), then paste the token here.
error.invalidToken: That token is invalid or has expired. Copy a fresh one from the workspace: click the avatar at the bottom left → $t(common.workspaceMenu.copyToken).

quickConnect.createOnWeb: Need a new workspace? Sign in and create one at

rename.title: Rename workspace
rename.label: Display name
rename.hint: Shown on this machine only. The slug ({{slug}}) and the workspace’s own name are unchanged.
rename.hintRemote: The workspace’s own name. The slug ({{slug}}) and existing links are unchanged.
rename.applyRemote: Rename it on the server too — all members
rename.remoteWarningBody: Only the displayed name changes; members, links, agents and history are unaffected.

emptyNoFilterMatch: Every workspace you have is in another state right now.

qrcode.dialogDescription: Scan to open {{name}} on another device.
qrcode.clickToCopy: Click the code to copy the link
qrcode.unavailable: This workspace has no token, so it has no shareable link.

manualDeprecation.notice: Manual token connection is being retired in favor of device pairing. It still works for now, but pairing is the recommended path.

unpairDialog.title: Unpair this device from "{{name}}"?
unpairDialog.body: The device stops appearing in the workspace and its agents there go offline. The workspace itself and your local agents are kept — you can re-pair any time with a new code.
